decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;margin-top:0cm;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
8.0pt;mso-margin-top-alt:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">The proposed change of use would result in a net loss of
industrial floorspace from the borough stocks, for which there is an evidenced
strategic need to retain. The submitted information is unable to justify this
loss of floorspace, therefore the proposal is contrary to Policy E4 of the London
Plan (2021), policy CS1 (O) of Harrow’s Core Strategy (2012) and policy DM 31 C
and D of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;margin-top:0cm;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
8.0pt;mso-margin-top-alt:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Insufficient information has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority to demonstrate that the proposed Banqueting Hall &nbsp;(Sui Generis) would be a compatible use with
the adjoining industrial uses within the Brember Road Industrial Park, and not
to the detriment of existing occupiers within the Industrial Park. The proposal
therefore fails to accord with policies DM1, DM31 and DM46 of the Harrow
Development Management policies Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;margin-top:0cm;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
8.0pt;mso-margin-top-alt:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Insufficient information has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority to demonstrate whether the proposed Banqueting Hall &nbsp;(Sui Generis), would not unacceptably harm the
free flow and safety of the highway. There are concerns that the proposal would
result in injudicious parking within the Brember Road Industrial Park and
adjoining residential streets thereby exacerbating an already congested parking
situation to the detriment of neighbouring amenity and highway and pedestrian
safety. The proposal therefore fails to accord with policies T.6 and T6.4 of
The London Plan (2021), and policies DM1, DM42 and DM46 of the Harrow
Development Management policies Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal">Insufficient information has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that</span><span style="page-break-after:avoid"><span style="line-height: 107%;">&nbsp;the proposed Banqeting Hall would not lead to adverse impacts on the amenity of neighbouring residential properties. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with policies DM1 and DM46 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and policy&nbsp;D14 of The London Plan (2021).&nbsp;</span></span><br></p>
description: Change of use from warehouse (B8) to banqueting hall (Sui Generis)
